verdict.rationale: LocalAI is built to be self-hosted. The docs give a one-line Docker deployment, a single binary serving an OpenAI-compatible API on localhost, and a tested CPU path that needs no GPU. Distributed mode, multi-user auth and a GitHub repo show the core product runs entirely on the user's own infrastructure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment beyond first-party docs and the README.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: You can use it with any OpenAI SDK or client by pointing it to http://localhost:8080.
One binary with an OpenAI-compatible API in front of it.
Every feature ships a CPU path first.
